families.label: Shared (pool) account payouts
families.description: fund_account_payout_shared / fund_account_payout_sub_balance processors: merchant sits on a shared RazorpayX pool balance. Create -> pricing -> credits -> ledger/transaction -> FTS -> status. Entry via POST /v1/payouts (monolith proxy) or POST /v2/payouts.

families.label: Direct (current-account) payouts
families.description: fund_account_payout_direct processor: merchant's own bank current account (RBL/ICICI/Axis...). Adds banking_accounts credential lookup, in-flight balance reservation, partner-bank downtime holds and direct-account ledger events (da_ext_debit / da_payout_processed).

families.label: Bulk / batch payouts
families.description: POST /v1/payouts/bulk/validate then POST /v1/payouts/bulk -> bulk_idempotency_keys -> bulk_payouts worker per row. NEFT/RTGS rows park in batch_submitted until the window, then batch_submitted_merchants fans out per merchant (cron /v1/cron/process_batch_submitted_payouts).

families.label: Maker-checker approval workflow
families.description: IsWorkflowApplicable -> CreateWorkflow (Twirp WorkflowAPI/Create) with four callback URLs; payout parks in pending; workflows service calls back /v1/workflow/state[,/:id] and /v1/payouts/payouts_internal/:id/{approve,reject}. Gated by DCS Workflows object (enable_payout_workflow + skip_* fields) and splitz payout_workflows_dcs_name_experiment.

families.label: Failure, reversal and cancellation
families.description: Reversal rows (reversals table) + payout_status_details; cancel_payout for queued|scheduled|on_hold; payout_create_failure_handling / payout_update_failure_handling workers compensate half-written creates and status updates; free-payout/credit unwind on failure.

families.label: Queued payouts (low balance)
families.description: queue_if_low_balance=true parks the payout in queued; the queueing strategy uses the DCS balance buffer fields; release happens on x-balances balance-refresh events, on balance_update_event, or via the /v1/cron/process_queued_low_balance_payouts cron -> queued_payout worker. The in-flight reservation store (Redis) is the fail-closed dispatch gate.

families.label: Scheduled payouts
families.description: scheduled_at in the future -> state scheduled; GET /v1/payouts/schedule/timeslots exposes slots; /v1/cron/process_scheduled_payouts (and internal /v1/payouts/scheduled/process) dispatch one schedule_payout job per due payout.

families.label: On-hold payouts (beneficiary bank + partner bank downtime)
families.description: HoldPayoutIfBeneBankDown parks a payout in on_hold when the bene bank is down; a separate partner-bank-downtime path (splitz partner_bank_on_hold_payouts_experiment) uses the partner_bank_hold_payouts worker and /v1/cron/process_queued_payouts. Merchant SLAs are set via POST /v1/merchant/update_on_hold_slas; FTS notifies downtime on /v1/notify/downtime.

families.label: Pricing, free payouts, credits and fee recovery
families.description: FetchPricing (pricing rules cached in Redis via /v1/payouts/set_pricing_rule_info) + DeductCredits + free-payout counters (counters / counter_transaction tables, admin free_payout endpoints) + rzp_fees_payout fee-recovery creates. free_payouts_xbalances_experiment moves counters to x-balances.

families.label: Idempotency keys, duplicate prevention and retries
families.description: IdempotencyKey middleware keyed on X-Payout-Idempotency (+ X-Payout-Actor-Id / -Actor-Type headers) with a request hash in idempotency_keys; exclusions in idempotency_key_exclusions (GET /v1/idempotency-keys/check-excluded); duplicate_prevention_config + shield/duplicate evaluate; payout_attempts records retries; POST /v1/payouts/retry re-drives failed payouts.

families.label: Merchant webhooks (Stork)
families.description: State-machine Enter hooks call FireWebhookEventAsyncForPayout, which enqueues webhook_event jobs; eight payout.* event types; event_outbox table; suppression rule for PayoutNotEnoughBalanceBanking failures on creation routes.

families.label: Internal service-to-service routes
families.description: 28 /v1/payouts internal endpoints behind a 7-credential BasicAuth allow-list plus x-balances (/v1/internal/*), FTS (/v1/notify/*, GET /v1/banking_account_statement), workflows (/v1/workflow/*), banking-accounts (/v1/merchant_onboarding), merchant-configuration and payloadcrypt groups.

families.label: Admin / ops actions
families.description: /v1/admin/* (admin passport) entity fetch, free-payout attribute updates, payout details sync, SELECT-only query_db, manual_action, log sampling, redis_key_set, merchant configuration and merchant feature-cache invalidation.

families.label: Async worker fabric (SQS jobs)
families.description: 25 registered jobs, one process per PAYOUTS_WORKER_NAME, SQS driver with visibilityTimeout 120s / waitTimeout 30s; per-job MaxRetries 3-7 and Timeout 30-1800s; a generic_processing catch-all keyed by processType. 15 of the 25 run in the twin.

families.label: Fund management payouts (FMP)
families.description: Admin/cron sets a per-merchant balance config (/v1/fund-management-payout/balance-config/...); /v1/cron/fund_management_payouts/check dispatches one fund_management_payout_check job per merchant; when a top-up is required a fund_management_payout_initiate job creates the FMP payout. Config lives in the DCS ApiInterface fmp_config field.

families.label: VA-source / sub-balance and credit-transfer payouts
families.description: HandleIfVaToVaPayout routes virtual-account-sourced payouts onto va_to_va ledger events; fund_account_payout_sub_balance processor serves sub-balances (assume_sub_account); MakeCreditTransferCreateRequest + PATCH /v1/payouts/update_credit_transfer_payout close the credit-transfer leg; x_balance_payouts_event consumes x-balances payout events.

families.label: Payout source notification (payout_links / vendor_payments / xpayroll / ...)
families.description: payout_sources + source_request_id_mapping record which product created the payout; the payout_source_updater worker notifies the source on every status change, either by the legacy path or by SNS fan-out to per-source topics (splitz source_updater_sns_experiment). FTS also re-drives it through POST /v1/payouts/retry/source_update.

families.label: Dual-write and data-consistency checking
families.description: Forward dual-write of payout entities into the API monolith DB (async_dual_write, and a direct-push variant onto the monolith's own queue), reverse dual-write (/v1/cron/reverse_dual_write), a consistency checker fanning out data_consistency_checker/-event jobs, payouts_temp / fund_transfer_attempts_temp shadow tables and a TiDB consistency cron.

families.label: Banking account statement (BAS) fetch and recon
families.description: /v1/cron/banking_account_statement/fetch/initiate dispatches rbl_banking_account_statement jobs (Mozart RBL gateway, 1800s timeout, 7 retries); statements land in banking_account_statement[_details]; POST /v1/banking_account_statement/process/batch and /v1/payouts/banking_account_statement/payout_update close payouts post-recon. XAS statement source events are a second, parallel path.

families.label: Payout usage / property events
families.description: payout_usage_event_processing worker emits usage and payout-property events (kafka_event_via_ps) for downstream analytics, gated by forPayoutPropertiesEventEvaluate.

families.label: Payout fetch / list / status-details / search
families.description: GET /v1/payouts[/:id], fetch_multiple (public and cron variants), status_details, analytics, _meta/summary and the Elasticsearch-backed index. Read path is experiment-heavy: orchestrator fetch, API-DB fallback, microservice fetch.

families.label: Validation, risk (Shield) and duplicate evaluation
families.description: Payload validation (RZPValidator), ICICI 2FA/BaaS block, UPI VPA blacklist regex, Shield rule evaluation (/v1/payouts/shield/evaluate) and duplicate-payout evaluation.

families.label: Merchant onboarding and per-merchant configuration
families.description: POST /v1/merchant_onboarding (banking-accounts or FastCron creds) creates the PS-side merchant record; merchant_configurations rows are written by the merchant-configuration admin group and the /v1/cron/merchant_configuration endpoints; DCS objects hold the feature side.

families.label: Beneficiary contacts, fund accounts and validation (FAV)
families.description: PS-side cache of contacts/fund accounts (fund_accounts, bank_accounts, fundAccountCache, favContact/favFundAccount) sourced from CFA, plus the fund-account-validation flow: POST /v1/fund_accounts/validations -> FTS penny-drop -> callbacks on /update/fts and /update/vpa, with fav status details and reversals. UPI VPA resolution goes through the upiService VPA mapper.

families.label: SLA breach monitoring, stuck payouts and log sampling
families.description: /v1/cron/payouts_sla_breach_monitor queries TiDB for IMPS/UPI/NEFT SLA breaches; a stuck-payouts monitor and runtime log-sampling controls (/v1/cron/log_sampling) sit alongside it.
